textures.description: Wooden side surface with chunky grain and dark edge trim.
Sloped lectern top with a blank parchment inset; manuscript content remains a separate item.
Front panel with a small dark support detail.
Front with twelve empty type compartments and tiny metal drawer markers.
Plain wooden cabinet side panel.
Cabinet top with a small recessed metal tray area for accessories.
Angular dark ink bottle detail for the cabinet top.
Small wooden and metal roller detail stored with the cabinet.
Iron printing bed inset into a wooden press table.
Heavy wooden table side with dark reinforced edge.
Front fascia with simple iron reinforcement bands.
Front of upper press assembly with two wooden uprights and a metal platen.
Side surface of upper press frame and platen.
Roller detail in the press mechanism.
Angular metal-mounted wooden lever detail.
Square metal plate texture for brackets and platen fittings.
Wooden desk with a blank parchment writing inset.
Wooden desk side.
Desk front with a simple shallow drawer and wooden pull.
Raised wooden archive surface with an empty arrangement grid for fragments.
Thick wooden edge of the manuscript archive.
Archive front with reinforced rails.
Bookcase front with abstract book spines and no readable titles.
Solid wooden side panel of bookshelf.
Top wooden cap of bookshelf.

notes: These are first-pass tile textures for future block models, not complete block models or blockstates.
All textures are 16x16 PNGs and use only the documented project palette plus transparency.
No dynamic text, manuscript content, item letters, quantities, UI slots, or animation frames are baked in.
The Printing Press uses separate table and upper-mechanism texture groups; the in-game model can assemble them vertically.
The Letter Cabinet is a separate block and includes optional ink-well and roller detail textures for model geometry.
